❌ Session Cancellation: Thursday, July 23, 2026

We regret to inform you that our upcoming community user group meeting scheduled for this Thursday, July 23, 2026, has been cancelled. We sincerely apologize for the short notice and any inconvenience this may cause. The team is actively working with the speaker to reschedule this highly anticipated session, and a new date will be shared as soon as it is finalized.

🔸 Critical Infrastructure Update: Microsoft Community Tenant Retirement

The Microsoft Community Tenant (msftcommunity.com) is scheduled to be officially retired on Thursday, August 6, 2026. You can review the official policy statement directly from Microsoft here:
https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/mgci-news/community-and-education-tenant-retirement/4528125

This retirement poses immediate infrastructure challenges for the Data Driven community, as our foundational communication systems, document storage, and Microsoft Teams environments are hosted directly within this tenant. Our administration team is currently evaluating alternative hosting platforms to ensure the community continues its long-term operations seamlessly. No other operational changes are active at this time, and we appreciate your patience while we transition.

🛑 Future Data Driven Summit 2026 will not run

Following several consecutive years of hosting the industry's largest virtual data platforms summit - gathering dozens of expert speakers and thousands of global attendees - we have made the decision not to run the 2026 event. The Future Data Driven Summit series is officially paused for the year. This temporary suspension allows our administrative team to focus completely on rebuilding our community platform infrastructure ahead of the upcoming Microsoft tenant retirement.

🔸 New Community Contact Channels

Due to the upcoming retirement of the msftcommunity.com infrastructure, all historical email addresses using that domain extension will permanently stop functioning. To stay in touch with the management team, ask technical questions, or coordinate future presentation opportunities, please use our new unified public inbox:
contact@datadrivencommunity.com
